sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "furniture_manufacte"."Manufacturer_ID" AS e, SUM("furniture_manufacte"."Price_in_Dollar") AS m1 FROM "furniture_manufacte" GROUP BY "furniture_manufacte"."Manufacturer_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v") SELECT SUM("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3"
why: total of price of furniture from manufacturer per manufacturer (by Manufacturer_ID) (additive)
gap to the all average of total of price of furniture from manufacturer (all level)
